questions.question: What refactoring moves a fragment of code into a new method?
questions.explanation: Extract Method refactoring creates a new method from code fragments that can be grouped together.

questions.question: What code smell describes classes with too many responsibilities?
questions.explanation: Large Class smell occurs when a class tries to do too much, violating the Single Responsibility Principle.

questions.question: What metric measures how easily software can be modified?
questions.explanation: Maintainability Index calculates a value between 0 and 100 representing the ease of maintaining the code.

questions.question: What code smell describes unused code that's never executed?
questions.explanation: Dead Code is code that's never executed or used, cluttering the codebase and confusing developers.

questions.question: What technique automatically reformats code to match style guide?
questions.explanation: Code Formatting tools automatically adjust code layout to conform to defined style rules.

questions.question: What smell describes methods with too many parameters?
questions.explanation: Long Parameter List makes methods hard to understand and use, often indicating the need for parameter objects.

questions.question: What code smell describes primitive types used instead of objects?
questions.explanation: Primitive Obsession occurs when primitives are used for domain concepts that should be represented as objects.

questions.question: What Fowler refactoring moves code duplicated in every branch of a conditional outside the conditional?
questions.explanation: When the same code fragment appears in all branches of a conditional, this refactoring moves it outside so it executes once regardless of which branch is taken.

questions.question: What measures the number of bugs per unit of code?
questions.explanation: Bug Density measures the number of defects divided by the size of the software module or system.

questions.question: What practice reviews code changes before merging?
questions.explanation: Pull Request Reviews allow team members to comment on and approve code before it's merged into the main branch.

questions.question: What code smell occurs when one change forces many small edits across unrelated classes?
questions.explanation: Shotgun Surgery indicates a responsibility scattered across classes, so modifications require widespread edits.

questions.question: What code smell describes a chain of calls reaching through several objects, like a.getB().getC()?
questions.explanation: Message Chains couple a client to the entire navigation path; Hide Delegate refactoring fixes it.

questions.question: What refactoring relocates a method to the class where it most belongs?
questions.explanation: Move Method relocates a method to the class that uses it most or owns the data it manipulates.

questions.question: What metric suite measures code size and difficulty by counting operators and operands?
questions.explanation: Halstead metrics compute volume, difficulty, and effort from the counts of distinct operators and operands.

questions.question: What formal, meeting-based review process uses defined roles like moderator and inspector?
questions.explanation: Formal code inspections (Fagan inspections) use structured meetings with defined roles to systematically find defects.
